model: agentkit.limits.layer_budget: shot plus thermal noise detection at k = 1 sigma per half LSB, dense passive N x N layer, laser, modulators, DACs, ADCs and static power, per MAC. Parametric budget only.
hypothesis_under_test: H-A (guide v2 section 39): a passive optical layer in silica with its complete electronics needs less energy per useful MAC than a cited digital reference at equal output precision.

parameter_selection_rules.nominal: Typical value from a primary source for commercially available or routinely demonstrated components at 1550 nm (2015-2026). When a source gives a range, use its midpoint.
parameter_selection_rules.optimistic: Best peer-reviewed demonstrated value for the same quantity (not a projection or roadmap). When a source gives a range, use its favorable end.
parameter_selection_rules.converter_energy: Energy per sample from a cited converter: reported power divided by sample rate, or Walden figure of merit times 2^ENOB with ENOB equal to the comparison precision (8 bits).
parameter_selection_rules.optical_transmission: Product of two fiber-to-chip facets, on-chip propagation over 2 cm, modulator insertion loss and mesh excess loss, each cited; stated in the provenance string.
parameter_selection_rules.static_power_passive: Nominal: cited temperature-stabilization power for a passive glass chip. Optimistic: 0 W labeled ASSUMPTION (athermal passive operation).
parameter_selection_rules.programmable_variant: Informational only: mean heater power per thermo-optic shifter in fs-written glass (cited), two shifters per MZI, N(N-1)/2 MZIs.
parameter_selection_rules.every_value: Each parameter carries a provenance string with DOI or URL and location, or the label ASSUMPTION with its reason.

digital_references.old: Horowitz, ISSCC 2014, DOI 10.1109/ISSCC.2014.6757323, 45 nm: 8-bit integer multiply (0.2 pJ) plus 8-bit add (0.03 pJ) = 0.23 pJ per MAC, arithmetic only. Lenient to optics.
digital_references.modern: Most energy-efficient peer-reviewed (2021-2026) digital INT8 MAC array or accelerator macro at <= 7 nm, arithmetic or macro level, converted with 1 MAC = 2 operations: J/MAC = 2 / (TOPS/W) x 1e-12. Strict for optics.

decision_rule.kill: If the optimistic advantage factor versus the old reference is <= 1 at the primary point, H-A is discarded.
decision_rule.withdraw_headline: If the optimistic advantage factor versus the modern reference is < 1, H-A is withdrawn as headline hypothesis and kept as a registered negative.
decision_rule.conditional: If optimistic >= 1 but nominal < 1 versus the modern reference, H-A survives only as a conditional candidate that requires demonstrating the optimistic parameters.
decision_rule.survive: If both parameter sets give >= 1 versus the modern reference, H-A survives as a candidate (not confirmed: no measurement).

heldout_policy: No data split: deterministic budget. Parameter values are gathered after this commitment under the rules above and committed before the computation runs.
